name: Silver Key
body:
Aura strong enchantment; CL 13th; Slot none; Price 15,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This small, elaborate silver key grants whoever holds it the benefit of the Dreamer feat. If the bearer already has the Dreamer feat, the key allows him to travel to the Dreamlands even if his dream-self is dead.

While the bearer uses the key to travel to the Dreamlands, the key vanishes from the dreamer’s body and reappears upon the dreamer’s awakening. If the bearer of the key dies in the Dreamlands, the silver key ceases to exist.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 7,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells dream
